Assignment 04

Author

EPPS 6302 — Htoi San Roi

Published

October 15, 2025

Web Scrapping

Code 
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)

url_fx <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_by_foreign-exchange_reserves"

# 1. Read the page ----------------------------------------------------------

html_fx <- read_html(url_fx)

# 2. Get the main wikitable on the page ------------------------------------
#    (more robust than using the exact XPath index)

fx_tables <- html_fx %>%
  html_elements("table.wikitable") %>%   # all Wiki-style tables
  html_table(fill = TRUE)

length(fx_tables)        # just to see how many tables there are
[1] 2
Code 
fores <- fx_tables[[1]]  # the first wikitable is the one we want (the country list)

# Look at the original names (for debugging if needed)
print(names(fores))
[1] "Country(as recognized by the U.N.)" "Continent"                         
[3] "Foreign exchange reserves"          "Foreign exchange reserves"         
[5] "Foreign exchange reserves"          "Foreign exchange reserves"         
[7] "Last reporteddate"                  "Ref."
Code 
# 3. Drop columns with empty or NA names -----------------------------------

fores <- fores[, !is.na(names(fores)) & names(fores) != ""]
# Now check how many columns we have
print(ncol(fores))
[1] 8
Code 
# 4. Safely rename the first 6 columns by position -------------------------
#    (doesn't care what the original names are)

if (ncol(fores) < 6) {
  stop("The scraped table has fewer than 6 columns. Check the page structure.")
}

names(fores)[1:6] <- c("Rank", "Country", "Forexres", "Date", "Change", "Sources")

# Check the result
str(fores)

Code 
head(fores)
Code 
# 5. Clean Date: remove bracketed notes and turn into Date ------------------

fores <- fores %>%
  mutate(
    # drop anything after '['
    newdate_raw = str_split_fixed(Date, "\\[", n = 2)[, 1] %>% trimws(),
    # if it looks like "January 2024", add a dummy day: "1 January 2024"
    newdate_str = if_else(newdate_raw == "", NA_character_,
                          paste("1", newdate_raw)),
    newdate = dmy(newdate_str)
  )

fores[1:5, c("Date", "newdate_raw", "newdate")]
Code 
# 6. Remove first two summary rows and fix Rank + numeric fields -----------

newfores <- fores[-c(1, 2), ]

newfores <- newfores %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = as.integer(Rank),
    Forexres_num = Forexres %>%
      str_replace_all(",", "") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\$", "") %>%
      as.numeric(),
    Change_num = Change %>%
      str_replace_all("%", "") %>%
      str_replace_all(",", "") %>%
      as.numeric()
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rank))   # keep only rows that have a proper Rank

# 7. Final cleaned dataset --------------------------------------------------

cleanfores <- newfores %>%
  select(
    Rank,
    Country,
    Forexres_raw = Forexres,
    Forexres_num,
    Change_raw = Change,
    Change_num,
    Date_raw = Date,
    Date = newdate
  )

head(cleanfores)
